records.subject: You're in -- let's get Maple Logistics set up
records.body:
Hi Lin,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero customer replies to three outbound emails (email:b21acbe5, email:057a12d3, email:a0edcadc). No tickets, so no engagement signal at all. Team plan and active subscription give some chance of self-start in the remaining 8 days, but silence after a week is a strong negative.

draft.subject: One step to get Maple Logistics moving in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

I know you've heard from us a couple of times already, so I'll keep this short.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the first project is usually what makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Priya
